summary.text: Pat Pettey is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 6, and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2013.
Pat Pettey is listed as the ranking minority member of the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Pat Pettey served in the House (1993–1996) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2013.
Pat Pettey is listed as a member of the Ways and Means Committee, the Education Committee, the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee and the Public Health and Welfare Committee.
The Legislature lists Pat Pettey's occupation as Retired Educator.
